headings: (500 ML) POPPY FIELDS HAND AND BODY LIQUID SOAP

jsonld_raw.name: (500 ML) POPPY FIELDS HAND AND BODY LIQUID SOAP
jsonld_raw.description:
Perfumed hand and body liquid soap. Container with dispenser.

Poppy Fields | Created from fresh notes of bergamot and the spicy touch of pink pepper. The heart of the fragrance offers a magnificent scent captured by the essence of rose and ylang ylang. The roundness of vanilla and powdery notes provide a timeless sensuality.

Scent notes:
Top: pink berries, bergamot, violet, jasmine.
Heart: rose, geranium, ylang ylang, clove.
Base: musk, vanilla, amber.
